neighbours.label: words saying something spans or spreads over a geographic area (extends / stretches / spread across, straddles)
fire: The desert extends across much of the northern half of the country.
Pine forests stretch across thousands of square kilometres of the region.
The town straddles the border between the two provinces.
The disease has spread across the whole southern coast in a month.
The mountain range runs across three countries from east to west.
Wetlands cover large parts of the delta and reach far inland.
The company has offices scattered across Europe and Asia.
The storm system stretched from the coast deep into the interior.
quiet: The desert is hot and dry and gets very little rain each year.
Pine forests are a home for many birds of the region.
The town sits on a hill near the border of the two provinces.
The disease was first found in a small village on the southern coast.
The mountain range is famous for its snow and its old monasteries.
Wetlands are important for the birds and fish of the delta.
The company has its main office in a tall building in Berlin.
The storm system weakened before it reached the coast.

notes: Card: ' across' x4, ' spread' x3, ' extends' x2, ' travels' x2, 'stradd|les'; all describe extent over an area. Near misses keep geography but place things at a single point or describe them without extent.
